name: Piper J-4 Cub Coupe
summary: Piper's first side-by-side design: a wider-fuselage Cub variant of 1938–42 with a fully enclosed rear deck.

wings: High wing braced by one strut per side
engines: Single small flat-four, cowled on later versions
fuselage: Wider fabric fuselage with side-by-side seating

tellTales: Side-by-side two-seat cabin under a strut-braced high wing
Rounded, rolled-edge tail and a fully enclosed rear fuselage
Compact side-by-side cabin on a tailwheel

confusedWith.howToTell: The Coupe seats two side by side in a wider fuselage; the J-3 seats two in tandem.
The Coupe has the full-length Cub wing and a wider cabin; the Vagabond has a shorter wing.
The Coupe has a Cub-style rounded tail and wing; the Taylorcraft has a different, narrower fuselage and a more angular cabin.
The Coupe has a Cub wing and tail; the Chief has a deeper, rounder fuselage and its own tail shape.
